topic: Anxiety disorders and panic disorder: diagnosis and management
scope: 2014 Canadian guidelines for panic disorder and the other anxiety and related disorders, including CBT and antidepressant treatment.

keyRecommendations.text: CBT alone or CBT combined with pharmacotherapy should be considered first-line.
A three-trial meta-analysis found no benefit of psychotherapy plus benzodiazepines versus psychotherapy or medication alone.
SSRIs, SNRIs, NaSSAs, TCAs, MAOIs, and RIMAs have demonstrated some efficacy.

clinicalBottomLine: Consider CBT alone or with pharmacotherapy as first-line, and do not expect added benefit from combining psychotherapy with a benzodiazepine on the evidence cited.

source.title: Canadian clinical practice guidelines for the management of anxiety, posttraumatic stress and obsessive-compulsive disorders.
